title: External tensor sections on two affine factors
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec} k$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec} k$ be structure morphisms of affine schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $F,G$ be quasi-coherent module sheaves [pqf-def-coherent]. The canonical map [def-sc-scalar-global-sections-comparison] $\Gamma(X,F)\otimes_k\Gamma(Y,G)\to\Gamma(X\times_kY,\operatorname{pr}_1^*F\otimes\operatorname{pr}_2^*G)$ is bijective.

source.place: Tag 0BED, lemma-kunneth, affine case and canonical maps preceding equation-kunneth-on-cech; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BED

proof.text: The affine fibre-product coordinate-ring computation is used in its equivalent pushout form: Mathlib isPushout_appTop_of_isPullback applied to the canonical square. Transport the base ring along Scheme.ΓSpecIso and use CommRingCat.isPushout_iff_isPushout to obtain Algebra.IsPushout k A B C, for A=Gamma(X,O), B=Gamma(Y,O), C=Gamma(X times_k Y,O). The scalarMap composition formulas, the pullback condition, and the top-open appLE formulas give the two scalar towers.

Apply exists_tensorPullback_affine_sections at the top affine opens to both projections. Swap the tensor factors in each comparison, use its recorded C-linearity to make it C-linear, and use its bijectivity to obtain C-linear equivalences C tensor_A M to projection-pullback sections and C tensor_B N to the other projection-pullback sections. Their images of 1 tensor s are tensorPullbackTopSection, using PresheafOfModules.presheaf_map_apply_coe to compare restriction maps.

The private externalTensorAlgebraEquiv composes tensor commutativity, AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange A C C, tensor congruence with Algebra.IsPushout.cancelBaseChange k A B C N, tensor commutativity over A, and AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange k A A. This is an equivalence from (C tensor_A M) tensor_C (C tensor_B N) to M tensor_k N. The standard pure-tensor equations show it sends (1 tensor s) tensor (1 tensor t) to s tensor t. Invert it and tensor the two pullback-section equivalences to obtain the additive equivalence of ordinary section tensor modules, with the prescribed pure-tensor formula. All constructions and equations are Mathlib equivalences, so zero rings and zero modules require no separate assumption.

Transport quasi-coherence from ordinary pullback to tensorPullback using uniqueness of left adjoints to pushforward. The quasi-coherent affine tensor-section comparison at the top of the affine product is bijective. Compose it with the additive equivalence from the preceding steps. Its pure-tensor formula is definitionally externalGlobalSectionsTensor, and tensor induction proves equality on arbitrary tensors. Bijectivity follows by composition.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0BED, lemma-kunneth affine case; M2 implements the affine coordinate-ring step by Mathlib isPushout_appTop_of_isPullback and the module identity by IsPushout.cancelBaseChange, with canonical pure-tensor formulas.
